name: Hindi
notes: Around 600 million speakers including second-language use, mostly across northern India. Written in Devanagari, which is fully phonetic — every character has one sound, so once you know the script you can read anything aloud. Hindi and Urdu are essentially the same spoken language written in two different scripts.
syllabus: The whole Devanagari script and about 380 words and phrases — the core of CEFR A1 (roughly 500 words): family, the body, food, the house, the land and weather, animals, tools, directions, a hundred verbs and the postpositions that hold a sentence together. Enough to read any word aloud, ask for what you need and say what happened. Hindi and Urdu are the same spoken language, so this carries across to Pakistan too; only the script differs. Cards can be spoken aloud if Windows has a Hindi voice installed.
